film.title: Hardwood Bricks Spirit: Stand Up and Cheer (Ohio Bobcats)
film.description:
Hardwood Bricks Spirit, episode one: Ohio's fight song, "Stand Up and Cheer." Paul P. McNeely wrote it in 1909 for the University of Kansas, and Ohio University made it its own. The song is in the public domain; this is our own new performance. Then Whitey Ruiz tells what little is known about the man who wrote it. If you know more about Paul P. McNeely, tell us.

Steam engine: Gemini-generated. Campus photo: College Green, Athens, Ohio, by Matthew Hagan.

The singer and Whitey Ruiz are fictional AI characters with AI voices and are not affiliated with Ohio University or any school.

Local history... and college basketball. See more at https://hardwoodbricks.com
